in_sanskrit.name: Isharith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Isha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Isharith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Isharith is a Sanskrit name derived from Isha, the female form of Shiva, the God of creation and destruction. Isharith signifies the lord or protector of Isha. In Hindu mythology, Isha is considered the embodiment of creative energy and power.
